{{Quote|&hellip;Tam, Lio&hellip;|Skirata and Vau mention Tam in their mourning|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
'''Tam''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]],<ref name="Order 66" /> who was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. The clone was born and trained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]<ref name="SWE" /> as a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Order 66" /> Between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Tam was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Tam was later mourned by the Mandalorian training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] [[Kal Skirata]] and [[Walon Vau]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Order 66" /> Like all clones, Tam stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tam was mentioned in ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', the fourth novel in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2009]].<ref name="Order 66" />
